title: Cost centers
intro: Cost centers tag labor and payroll to venues, departments, or GL segments for reporting.

sections.title: Cost center list
steps: Review codes used on employees, positions, and schedules.
Add or edit centers before assigning them on employee records.
sections.caption: Cost centers tab.

sections.title: Cost center form
steps: Click Add or edit a row.
Enter code, name, and optional description.
Toggle active to retire a center without deleting history.
Save — the center appears on employee and scheduling forms.
sections.caption: Cost center create/edit modal.

fields.name: Code
fields.effect: Short unique identifier used in exports and integrations.

fields.name: Is active
fields.effect: Inactive centers cannot be selected on new records.
